diagnostic_evidence.quote: among the three extensions $u_{m-1}(S)\frown \ast,\ u_{m-1}(S)\frown 0,\ u_{m-1}(S)\frown 1$, choose $u_m(S)$ to be the $\prec$-least extension $v$ such that $\Sigma(v)\ \subseteq\ S\cap 2^m$. If no extension works, set $u_m(S):=\bot$.

issues.failure_explanation: The greedy selection rule in Definition A.3 commits irreversibly to prefix choices that can permanently derail the construction from finding a Silver tree. Specifically, let $S$ contain the Silver tree $S_{A,x}$ with $A=\{0\}$ and $x(0)=0$ (so $S$ contains every sequence starting with $0$), and suppose $S$ also contains the single node $1$ at level 1 with no descendants at level 2. At level $m=1$, $\Sigma(\ast) = \{0, 1\} \subseteq S \cap 2^1$, so the priority $\ast \prec 0 \prec 1$ forces $u_1(S) = \ast$. At level $m=2$, extending $u_1(S)$ requires searching among $\ast\ast$, $\ast 0$, and $\ast 1$. None of their cylinders are subsets of $S \cap 2^2$ because $10, 11 \notin S$. Thus $u_2(S) = \bot$, and by definition $u_m(S) = \bot$ for all $m \ge 2$. Consequently, $k_m(S) = 0$ for all $m \ge 2$, meaning that $F_S$ satisfies $F_S^2 = \mathrm{id}$ on $\mathcal{X}$, so $\sigma_{\mathrm{ap}}(\mathcal{K}_{F_S}) \subseteq \{-1, 1\}$. Since $z_0 \in \mathbb{T}$ is non-torsion, $z_0 \notin \sigma_{\mathrm{ap}}(\mathcal{K}_{F_S})$, disproving the claim that $S \in \mathcal{V} \implies z_0 \in \sigma_{\mathrm{ap}}(\mathcal{K}_{\Psi(S)})$.

failure_location.quote: By the star-priority construction of $u_m(S)$ (it chooses $\ast$ whenever that choice preserves $\Sigma(\cdot)\subseteq S\cap 2^m$), the pattern $u_m(S)$ has at least as many $\ast$-coordinates as any admissible witness pattern. In particular, $k_m(S)=|u_m(S)|_\ast \ \ge\ |w_m|_\ast\ =\ |m\setminus A|$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must replace the greedy prefix-based star-witness algorithm with an encoding that provably tracks Silver subtrees without premature termination on trees with spurious branching, or provide an alternative reduction to establish hardness.
issues.overall_effect: The reduction from Silver tree membership to Koopman approximate point spectrum membership fails in the forward direction. Consequently, the Borel reduction from ill-founded trees to the spectrum decision set fails, leaving the $\Sigma^1_1$-completeness of $A_{z_0}$, the $\mathrm{SCI}_A = \infty$ result, and the $\mathrm{SCI}_G = \infty$ lower bounds for the approximate point spectrum on $L^\infty$ unsupported.
issues.title: Greedy star-priority witness construction fails to trace Silver subtrees
issues.why_classification: The failure invalidates the central spectral reduction connecting descriptive set-theoretic hardness to the $L^\infty$ Koopman operator, directly collapsing all the paper's lower bound theorems for $L^\infty$ (both type A and type G). No local or source-supported modification can repair the dynamical encoding without an entirely new construction.
